make_atom14_masks: create atom14 and atom37 existence masks and index mappings for a protein feature dictionary
make_msa_feat: build one-hot encoded MSA features with deletion values and cluster profiles for protein data
make_masked_msa: create BERT-style masked MSA data by replacing residues with random or profile-weighted amino acids
sample_msa: sample a fixed number of MSA sequences randomly and store extras in extra_* fields
random_crop_to_size: crop protein features to a target residue count with optional template subsampling
